hero.title: Full Stack Developer
hero.subtitle: Full Stack Developer with experience in building systems with Laravel and Java, also using TypeScript, React and Angular

abilities: Led the migration of a legacy pure-PHP system to Laravel, implementing Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), database normalization and indexing, and ETL/Job pipelines to sanitize and migrate historical data with full integrity.
Integrated an internal AI knowledge base into the corporate search engine, unifying queries and Full-Text Search indexes across legacy systems and new contracts, reducing search times by 80%.
Implemented and refined OAuth2 authentication flows across internal ERPs, standardizing access control and inter-service security.
Developed an end-to-end operational time-tracking system for task-level hour logging and automated BI and managerial reporting across 8 teams.
Automated bulk population of complex forms via .XLSX file upload, parsing, and validation, eliminating manual rework and data-entry errors.
Structured isolated Development and Staging environments with CI pipelines and unit tests in Java and PHP, reducing production regressions.
Implemented event-driven automated transactional emails triggered by barcode scans, automating customer communications for ~1,000 orders/month.
Integrated external logistics APIs with robust exception handling, data resilience, and dynamic carrier reporting, reducing tracking synchronization failures by 70%.
Optimized background jobs and SQL queries across relational models and EAV (Entity-Attribute-Value) architectures, reducing processing time by 40%.
Refactored and maintained legacy PHP codebases within Agile (Scrum) workflows, actively participating in code reviews to reduce technical debt.
